name: Hope
source:
Most vampires fall out of touch with modern trends not long after their [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embrace[/url], but Hope's trajectory was the exact opposite - instead of shying away from technology, she doubled down on her mortal practices. 

The [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url] might be critical of Kindred using the internet after several high-profile Second Inquisition interventions, but if you ask Hope, those events stemmed from insufficient mastery of the digital. 

Hiding behind dozens of online handles, some of which have become ingrained in her psyche, this [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Malkavian_(VTM)]Malkavian[/url] feels secure in her nightly escapades into the Web for profit... and fun.

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
